description: Carry a message inside a confidential output's value rangeproof. Elements uses only the first 64 bytes of a rangeproof's message field, so about 3125 bytes per output are free — at no cost in transaction size or fee, and readable only by the holder of the output's blinding key.

Post.description: Publish a signed nostr event inside a confidential output's rangeproof. The event is signed by a key this wallet derives, so authorship survives the trip: a bridge that reads the chain and republishes to nostr is a transport, not an authority — it cannot forge events, and it runs on a view key that cannot spend.

recipient.description: A confidential Liquid address to carry the event. Whoever holds this address's blinding key is the only party who can read the note — so send it where the intended reader is looking: one of your own addresses if you want `read-messages` to find it, or an address covered by the descriptor a nostr bridge watches. An unblinded address has no rangeproof and is rejected.

content.description: The note's text. Roughly 3000 bytes fit once the event's JSON framing and signature are accounted for.

amount_sat.description: Satoshis to send to the recipient. The event rides along for free, so this only needs to clear the dust limit.

sign_with.description: Which wallet key signs the event: "wallet" (the general signing key), "oracle", or a BIP32 path. The resulting nostr identity is that key's x-only pubkey — the one `tx-manifest-wallet info` prints.

inputs.description: Wallet UTXO providing the funds and the fee.

ui.label: input funding the carrier output and the fee

outputs.description: The output whose rangeproof carries the event. It must be confidential — that is what gives it a rangeproof to write into — so the address must be a blinded one.

ui.label: the output carrying your nostr note

outputs.description: Change returned to the funding wallet.

Post.intent: post a nostr note on chain to {params.recipient}: {params.content}

Send.description: Pay a confidential address with a plain-text message in the rangeproof. Only the recipient can read it — the message is gated on the output's blinding key, which is theirs.

recipient.description: A confidential Liquid address. An unblinded address has no rangeproof and is rejected.

message.description: The text to embed. Up to 3125 bytes.

inputs.description: Wallet UTXO providing the funds and the fee.

ui.label: input funding the payment and the fee

outputs.description: The recipient's output, carrying the message.

ui.label: payment to the recipient, carrying your message

outputs.description: Change returned to the funding wallet.

Send.intent: send {params.amount_sat} sat with a private message: {params.message}
